import sys
import math

def gcd(a, b):
    if a == 0 or b == 0:
        return a + b
    if a > b:
        return gcd(a % b, b)
    return gcd(b, b % a)

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    a = []
    for i in range(n):
        a.append(int(data[1 + i]))
    
    T = int(data[1 + n])
    
    ans = 0
    a.sort()
    
    for i in range(n):
        p = i + 1
        while p < n and abs(a[i] - a[p]) <= T:
            p += 1
        ans = max(ans, p - i)
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
